I've been playing The Outer Worlds since Friday and I finally made it off the first planet and into space and have about 3.5 of the companions. I haven't completed the game yet so take that into consideration.

This games setting takes heavy inspiration from TV show Firefly, and that's a good thing. The gameplay is like Fallout New Vegas. The load screens are like Morrowind. Walking around your ship, the Unreliable reminds me of Mass Effect along with the Companions. The style of the settlements in the worlds along with the back story is like Bioshock Infinite. Even the main protagonist/antagonist is an anti-hero like The Doctor. This game ticks off a lot of the right boxes. And in fairness, they are not ripping off these games as they have devs from a lot of these games that worked on TOW, and it shows, this game is epic.

Now for the Based Report. I'm told there is no romancing the companion in this game so that is a plus, and so far the most I have done is trying to point out to Pavarti (think Kaylee from Firefly) that one of the men in her colony had a crush on her but she's a total geek girl and brushes it off as. When you roll your character, your gender choices are Male and Female (Thank God!). There are zero Celebrity voice overs or voice actors which is refreshing. I looked up the voice actor and they all have tonnes of other video games and cartoons under their belt, so nothing but pros in this game. So far I have run into ZERO SJW bullshit. No Mary-Sues either. No racial themes. Nothing. I'll post an update if I find anything later in the game.

I have been pleasantly surprised by how much I like the companion Parvati. In the ads for the game I thought I would dislike her but she's pretty cool. A genuine geek girl. Her dialogue is genuinely enjoyable and the character is very useful. You end up feeling a lot of sympathy for her, not because she was born with a vagina or any of that nonsense, but because she has been treated like absolute shit her entire life by a shit corporation, and she has just gone along with it. She's definitely an accurate portrayal of a real life Aspie. You also recruit a Vicar early on, similar to Shephard on Firefly but a white guy that's actually more of archaeologist. I won't spoil it but there's a good reason he's kind of a bad Vicar. There's also this robot named SAM sitting in your ship but I haven't finished the quest to activate him. Reminds me of doing the same to activate HK-47 in SW:KOTOR2. Again, same devs.

Instead of VATS, you have Time Dilation which actually makes logical sense within the logic of the game (your character was left in suspended animation for several times longer than normally possible and it's a side effect). Weapons degrade quickly early on in the game but that's part of the story so don't sweat it, there are so many dropped you'll never actually have to buy one on the first planet.

I'll stop there for now. I am loving this game. They have single highhandedly resurrected an entire genre, with no microtransactions, no paid mods, not even in game pre-order bonuses. Just a classic replayable RPG Shooter with no controversy. I hope this leads to more and more RPG Shooters coming out.

EDIT: Forgot to mention ADA, the ship's computer. She keeps making me laugh my ass off. Very very funny!
